pins.name: OUT
pins.notes: Middle of the divider: NTC to 3.3 V, 10 kΩ to GND. To an ADC pin (ADC1 on ESP32). The voltage rises as it gets warmer

pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: Use 3V3 so the output stays in the ADC range

gotchas.text: An NTC is not linear: convert with the Beta formula (B25/85 = 3977 K for this type) or a table, not a straight line.
